title: The transported lax pushforward structure on sheafification generators
statement:
Fix a universe $\mathcal V$, two $\mathcal V$-small sites $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category $\mathcal A$ relative to $\mathcal V$, with $\mathcal V$-small morphism sets. Use the canonical sheafified pointwise tensors and strong monoidal sheafification functors of [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators]. Write $a_C\dashv U_C$, $a_D\dashv U_D$ for sheafification and inclusion, $\eta_C,\eta_D$ for their units and $\epsilon_C,\epsilon_D$ for their counits. Write $t_C,t_D$ and $u_C,u_D$ for their tensor and unit generators. Let $E:C\to D$ be a functor such that restriction $r(P)=P\circ E^{\mathrm{op}}$ takes $K$-sheaves to $J$-sheaves, and let $R:\operatorname{Sh}(D,K;\mathcal A)\to\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;\mathcal A)$ be that restriction, so $U_CR=rU_D$. Give $U_D$ the lax structure right-adjoint to the strong structure on $a_D$ [lem-sfb-monoidal-adjunction-mates]; give $r$ its pointwise strong monoidal structure; and give $R$ the lax structure transported from $a_CrU_D$ along the counit isomorphism $a_CU_CR\xrightarrow{\epsilon_C R}R$. Then its tensor and unit comparisons $\mu_R$ and $e_R$ satisfy, for every pair of sheaves $F,G$ on $D$,
$$
U_C(\mu_{R,F,G})\circ t_C(RF,RG)=r(t_D(F,G)),\qquad U_C(e_R)\circ u_C=r(u_D).
$$
Equivalently, the transported structure maps are the unique sheaf extensions of $r(t_D(F,G))$ and $r(u_D)$ along the actual sheafification units. No assertion that evaluation preserves sheaf tensor products is made.
